spec_match.rationale: Implements the explainer's second use case (2D swipe-dismiss) on a native scroller with scroll-axis-lock: none, with dismissal and drift computed from real scroll offsets — no touch-action:none, no pointer math.

interactive.rationale: Scrolling the stage drives the card's fade and the live progress/drift meter; the dismissal threshold announces completion; re-center resets.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises scroll-offset-driven dismissal with live drift; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Unknown-property engines get the honest drift≈0 prediction; a scrollbar-layout race that left a phantom -14px initial drift was found by the harness and fixed with a pre-interaction ResizeObserver re-center.

conformance.rationale: Rides the same manual gesture assertion as the dual stage; the value-level contracts run live in the suite.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP runs (fresh reload after the final edit): drift starts at 0 on both classes, scrolling to the top edge reaches 100% dismissed with the real drift value, re-center restores 0/0; zero console errors; 0px overflow; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: sal-dismiss-completed asserts once per completed dismissal with the drift value.

design_system.rationale: Card art is an inline SVG using theme colours; meter on paper (AA); CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: The stage is a labelled focusable region; the meter is aria-live text; the SVG has a role=img label; reset is a native button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Stage is width-capped; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000; touch-action pan-x pan-y preserved for stage gestures.

openQuestions.title: Feel the drift difference on touch hardware with Chrome 153
openQuestions.detail: On a pre-153 browser a vertical-start swipe locks (drift pinned near 0); with the property the drift follows the finger. Verify on a touch device and note the felt difference.

guidanceConsulted.query: progress meter aria-live scroll driven state
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Expose visually-driven progress as announced text.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The meter is role=status aria-live and carries progress + drift as text; the fade is reinforcement, not the only signal.

guidanceConsulted.query: centered card oversized scroll space mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Grid place-items centering inside an oversized scroll space; cap the stage width.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: dismiss-space is a 200% grid with place-items:center; stage is min(24rem,100%); verified 0px overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Drive scroll-linked effects from passive listeners with bounded work.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Single passive scroll handler updating opacity and one text node.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the harness caught a real initial-drift bug (stale center after scrollbar layout), the fix was applied, and the full sequence re-verified from a fresh reload on both classes — 0 drift at rest, 100% dismissal with honest drift, clean reset. Touch-hardware verification of the felt locking difference is the open question.
